shortcut.previousmodalcontrol.note: WO022-1: Shift+Tab cycles modal fields back — find-dialog pre opens the Find panel (#btn-find, Home ▸ Editing; search input auto-focuses), Shift+Tab moves activeElement to the previous tabbable control (find input → canvas): native focus nav observable in the react canvas editor

shortcut.movetolowerheaderfooter.note: WO022-1: the react canvas editor's 'jump into the footer' surface is entering footer editing — Insert ▸ Page Number (#btn-insert-page-number) sets headerFooterMode=footer (word-commands.ts) and the footer region [data-header-footer-region=footer] mounts (absent before the click) as an editable tiptap (Viewport.tsx)

shortcut.movetoupperheaderfooter.note: WO022-1: the react canvas editor's 'jump into the header' surface is entering header editing — Insert ▸ Date & Time (#btn-insert-date-time) sets headerFooterMode=header and writes a timestamp into headerHtml (word-commands.ts); the header region mounts carrying the timestamp text (tiptap drops the data-wo-field span, so the date text is asserted)

shortcut.movetolowerheader.note: WO022-1: the react canvas editor's 'caret into the footer' surface is entering footer editing — Insert ▸ Footer (#btn-edit-footer) sets headerFooterMode=footer (word-commands.ts) and the footer region [data-header-footer-region=footer] mounts (absent before the click) as an editable tiptap

shortcut.movetoupperheader.note: WO022-1: the react canvas editor's 'caret into the header' surface is entering header editing — Insert ▸ Header (#btn-edit-header) sets headerFooterMode=header (word-commands.ts) and the header region [data-header-footer-region=header] mounts (absent before the click) as an editable tiptap

shortcut.endparagraph.note: WO022-1: the canvas body has no DOM selection — End is exercised on the react editor's only DOM text surface: the hf-caret pre enters footer editing (Insert ▸ Footer) with the caret at the start of the 'Footer' text; End natively moves it to the paragraph end (offset 1→6)
